expectation_origin: Handwritten from PROMPTS.md sections 3.2-3.4 and explicit Prompt 2-4 examples; no analyzers or analyzer outputs used.

compilation.reason: No Solidity compiler invoked while writing expectations; Tree-sitter parsing is not compiler validation.

semantic_scope: Exhaustive forward relation edges between original HCG statement/declaration endpoints and projected environment nodes; no REV relations or transitive closure.
endpoint_text_policy: Complete source statements normalized by collapsing whitespace. For condition/update control endpoints the complete if/while/for statement identifies the AST node; for parameters the complete function definition identifies the entry node. State declarations retain visibility/storage qualifiers. These strings are source identity selectors, not parser output.
notes: Approved by user during Prompt 6: one tuple assignment is one original HCG node. This oracle checks x/y inputs and separate a/b consumers and does not claim to prove within-node x-to-a and y-to-b value provenance. No new variable nodes are introduced.
